summary.text: PIZZA PANCETTA HK AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2019-08-12. PIZZA PANCETTA HK AS registers its business as operating pizza restaurants, delivering takeaway food, providing courses within the industry, and other products or services naturally related to this, including participating in other companies with similar activities and buying and selling shares or otherwise making itself attractive to other enterprises. Its main industry code is 56.110: restaurant activities. The register shows 6 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 3 151 278 NOK and the annual result was 34 904 NOK; operating income was up from 3 033 643 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 46 403 NOK in 2024 to 34 904 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -68 277 NOK in 2024 to -33 373 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Gyunay Hikmetov Syuleymanov (daglig leder and styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 5 on 2026-02-13 to 6 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
